programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: A young Venetian, Marco is abandoned by his father for the merchant Silk Road in the hands of the Mongolian emperor, Kublai Khan, who is at war with China. Kublai recognizes Marco's observation skills, and teaches him the Mongolian culture.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: 1800:- Young Edmund Talbot is sailing to Australia to take up a government post, on a decrepit old ship skippered by Captain Anderson, who is hostile to Edmund until he realizes that he has important relatives. Far more admirable to Edmund are Lieutenants Summer, who has worked his way up through the ranks, and the dashing Deverel. His fellow passengers number demure governess Miss Granham, the republican Mr Prettiman and artist Mr Brocklebank, travelling with his wife and daughter Zenobia - who initiates Edmund into sex - though ultimately he realizes that they are not related, merely a carnal ménage a trois. Also on board is the gauche young vicar Colley, who inadvertently breaches protocol by going onto the bridge uninvited. Ashamed he gets drunk and has gay sex with crew members before locking himself in his cabin, where, despite Edmund's efforts to bring about reconciliation, he wastes away and dies.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: Otto is waiting for a very important package, but the conveyor belt at the ABDS breaks down.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 1: Mystery Weekend
programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: The ship is becalmed and another vessel is sighted, which turns out to be British - the Alcyone, whose commander announces that the war with France is over. The two vessels anchor alongside and a ball is held for the passengers. Here Edmund meets the sweet Marion Chumley, though he has a rival for affections in Deverel. However, when the two ships part Deverel is exchanged for the Alcyone's officer, the urbane Benet and Edmund confides in Summers his regret at having to say goodbye to Marion. A storm blows up, during which the unfortunate steward Wheeler, considered a Jonah, is thrown overboard and Prettiman severely injured, being nursed rather unexpectedly by Miss Grnham. A mast is also broken and Benet and Summers disagree over the best way to mend it.

programme.title: Stranger with My Face
programme.desc: After the death of her father, Laurie and her mother and sister make their summer vacation house their permanent residence. After starting school, Laurie's friends see her in places where she wasn't, and accuse her of doing things she didn't do. Her own sister even accuses her of trying to choke her in her sleep.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: Double Wedding
programme.desc: Rom-com with Tamara Mowry-Housley and Tia Mowry-Hardrict. Identical twins unknowingly fall for the same man - who's unaware he's dating two girls - and when they invite him to a family event, chaos erupts.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Drama with James Earl Jones. A widower opens a reading room, where people can learn to read. But despite his goodwill, problems in the neighbourhood threaten his establishment.

programme.title: The Yeltsin Project
programme.desc: Comedy drama with Jeff Goldblum. During the Russian presidential elections in 1996, three American political consultants head to Russia to help a political candidate win.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 2: Snapshot
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: Edmund acts as a witness to the wedding between the injured Prettiman and Miss Granham, with flowers grown by the captain in his window boxes. Despite initial animosity towards him Edmund starts to show some admiration for the older man's liberal ideas. With the mast broken the ship is drifting perilously close to an ice-field but Benet saves the situation by pouring molten lead into the mast's base, which steadies it and the ship reaches Sydney safely. Due to Edmund's influence Summers is given his own ship but dies when it catches fire though for Edmund there is a happy ending as he is reconciled with Marion, who has also arrived in Sydney.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: The escapees' party has got away in one boat, ill-prepared, and after bitter bickering decides to risk sailing to the Dutch Indies. Despite lack of wind, they finally reach Timor. There they pretend to be shipwrecked rich Englishmen and live in luxury on credit for years. When lieutenant Clark passes the island on his way home, he discovers the escaped criminals. William is killed resisting arrest, the rest caught and put on trial in London. The public and press sympathize with the adventurers.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: 1800:- Young Edmund Talbot is sailing to Australia to take up a government post, on a decrepit old ship skippered by Captain Anderson, who is hostile to Edmund until he realizes that he has important relatives. Far more admirable to Edmund are Lieutenants Summer, who has worked his way up through the ranks, and the dashing Deverel. His fellow passengers number demure governess Miss Granham, the republican Mr Prettiman and artist Mr Brocklebank, travelling with his wife and daughter Zenobia - who initiates Edmund into sex - though ultimately he realizes that they are not related, merely a carnal ménage a trois. Also on board is the gauche young vicar Colley, who inadvertently breaches protocol by going onto the bridge uninvited. Ashamed he gets drunk and has gay sex with crew members before locking himself in his cabin, where, despite Edmund's efforts to bring about reconciliation, he wastes away and dies.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Belgrado „Crvena Zvezda“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Compilation
programme.desc: Pula, the leopard ruler of the dark heart of the kingdom, faces a tough choice between her true love and her legacy. When Pula gives birth to Motshidi, it is her last chance at a dynasty. Blue Eyes, Motshidi's father, cannot be trusted. He has been known to kill younglings. Pula must protect and train Motshidi to take her rightful place in the kingdom as Pula's health weakens.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: In an action packed episode of Animal Fight Club we reveal what happens when the Animal Kingdom's most vicious species fight tooth and claw in the deadliest of conflicts. With exclusive user generated content and footage from top wildlife filmmakers, this episode sheds new light on the fiercest fights Mother Nature has to offer, proving that it's not always the animal you expect that ends up coming out on top ….

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Survival is a daunting proposition. But when the going gets tough, the wild inhabitants morph into oddballs. Millennia of weird evolution have made this giant continent a land of mutants. Expect the unexpected because here, outlandish is the new normal.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Buffaloes fiercely defend their own against lions. Elephants assert their power, as one bull boldly confronts a vehicle full of people. A cape ground squirrel stares death in the face, and male lions strike at hyenas. Around the next bend, baby animals bust a move, and a tenacious croc targets elephants with relentless 24/7 hunts. Intense, empowered and unfiltered, safari sights always surprise!

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Dust
programme.desc: In Botswana, where the Okavango Delta fades into the Kalahari, water and desert clash in a yearly cycle of abundance and loss. Along Africa's longest zebra migration, herds, predators and desert survivors depend on the fleeting lifeline of the Boteti River. Elephants, lions and hyenas converge as shrinking water forces dangerous encounters, while thousands of zebras must choose between starvation and a perilous journey to the Makgadikgadi salt pans. When rains arrive, the desert briefly transforms, flamingos flood the pans and life surges, before heat returns and the cycle begins again. Combining cinematic spectacle with intimate storytelling, "Dust" explores resilience, climate and survival in a rapidly changing world.

programme.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Lions assert their dominance with ruthless precision, overpowering a hyena with ease. But not every predator submits. Wild dogs return to challenge the balance of power, and when a leopard mother stands her ground against a lion to defend her cubs, survival becomes fierce, raw and unforgiving in the fight to rule the wild.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: Far in the Pacific, 250 miles from Honolulu, a hidden wilderness teems with life ... the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. In this special, come aboard a voyage led by scientists from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration who are researching disease-plagued coral reefs, endangered monk seals and the millions of birds nesting in the volcanic islands and atolls.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: The Boteti River is a vital, dry-season pitstop for the tens of thousands of animals that rely on its life-saving water during the annual migration between the Okavango Delta and the Makgadikgadi grasslands. When it unexpectedly stops flowing for 20 years, all life is forced to adapt to the reality of a long and enduring drought.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Lion Brothers: Cubs To Kings
programme.desc: There's one thing that Leo has on his mind from birth - power. And he'll stop at nothing to get it. But life has other ideas and throws the book at this young upstart. With brother Max by his side, can Leo face his challenges and overcome his arrogance to become the King he's always dreamed he'd be?

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee. Lost and alone, Kio's chances of survival are slim, but he finds the courage to call out and reunites with his brothers. Together, they face a series of trials, from buffalo hunts to clashes with rival males, forging an unbreakable bond. Finally, as a confident male lion, almost fully grown, Kio returns to the marshland to face the old kings. Victory will secure a kingdom, a pride and a new family. Defeat means exile. Will Kio fall, or rise and finally claim his place as king?

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: Across China's forest, jungle and high-mountain realms live the wonderfully bizarre and the breathtakingly beautiful. Survival in these hidden kingdoms often requires a unique adaptation. A young giant panda gets a lesson in tree climbing, cool caterpillars show off their colors, and the world's only venomous primate, the slow loris, enjoys a stealthy snack. These incredible stories offer a rare glimpse into a remarkable world.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to southern Vietnam's tropical habitats, home to gibbons and playful macaques, green sea turtles, and Asian black bears. Reintroduced Siamese crocodiles roam the Bau Sau wetlands. The vast Mekong Delta boasts small-clawed otters and thousands of migrating birds, from openbill storks to Oriental darters.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: At the end of the Ghost River lies an ancient salt pan. Instinct drives thousands of animals from across the Kalahari to converge here, seeking refuge in one of Africa's greatest gambles — where an extraordinary transformation can turn dust and death into life, almost overnight. But this refuge is fickle and exists on unreliable annual rainfall. This year, will Nxai Pan provide a life-giving stopover on Kalahari's greatest migratory route, or will it mean death in the dust for all?

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators: Compilation
programme.desc: Our rivers and oceans are ruthless battlefields, constantly testing the bravery of even the biggest and deadliest carnivores. Regardless of temperature, depth or terrain, every marine habitat calls for unique body designs, exquisitely evolved senses, and outrageously complex - or bizarre - tactics for success.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: Far in the Pacific, 250 miles from Honolulu, a hidden wilderness teems with life ... the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. In 2006, the islands were declared a national monument, in large part because of the area's more than 7,000 marine species. In this special, come aboard a voyage led by scientists from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration who are researching disease-plagued coral reefs, endangered monk seals and the millions of birds nesting in the volcanic islands and atolls.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: The lines between hunter and hunted become blurred in this epic safari. Hold on to your seats as an elephant charges through the bush with a lion dangling from its tusks. Watch as male leopards engage in a turf war, and a pack of hyenas bully a lion off of his buffalo kill. The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: There are still places on Earth where fields of grass stretch as far as the eye can see. In order to survive in these open spaces, predators must hide in plain sight. On the vast plains of the African savanna, banded mongooses rely on strength in numbers in order to succeed in a land of giants. Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Secret Life of Predators is a National Geography documentary series narrated by Boone Smith, exploring animals that are on the top of the food chains in the environments they inhabit, such as eagles, tigers and bears. Meet some of the deadliest creatures, from rainforests and African savannas to the depths of the ocean. Find out the strategies these animals use to fight for their survival, and why are these hunter species the most successful when it comes to it.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: When the savannah turns into a battleground, it's hard to choose a hero. We're on the edge of our safari seats as a leopard is cornered by a pride of lions, a young impala is hurled into the air by a hippo and two hyenas try to drown each other. Then, the rarest of sightings as an Aardvark runs for its life from a brown hyaena. Who will win when it's tooth versus claw?

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you'll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. In spring, tall grass helps babies hide out of sight, but it also camouflages predators on the prowl. This game drive captures extraordinary behaviour as families and individuals battle to eat, defend, and raise young.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: The lines between hunter and hunted become blurred in this epic safari. Hold on to your seats as an elephant charges through the bush with a lion dangling from its tusks. Watch as male leopards engage in a turf war, and a pack of hyenas bully a lion off of his buffalo kill. The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: Tucci Italijoje
programme.desc: Amerikiečių aktorius Stanley Tucci - vienas įvairiapusiškiausių žmonių Holivude. Iš Italijos kilęs vyras kino filmuose nesunkiai gali persikūnyti į žudiką, aukštosios mados dizainerį, linksmą sutuoktinį, landų žurnalistą, piktą žmogų ar keistuolį. Už filmavimo aikštelės ribų - jis gyvenimu besidžiaugiantis žmogus, su puikiu humoro jausmu ir didžiule meile gardžiam maistui. Tad ne nuostabu, kad jis kviečia žiūrovus atrasti tikrąją Italiją. Italijos regionų išskirtinumą, kuris geriausiai atsiskleidžia ruošiamuose patiekaluose. Stanley mėgaujasi maisto meniškumu vaizdingoje Toskanoje, aplanko Florenciją ir Sieną. Pasineria į kulinarinio kūrybiškumo dvasią Renesanso gimtinėje. Italijos pramoninėje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja novatorišką virtuvę ir futuristinį ūkininkavimą. Italijos vokiškai kalbančioje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja dvigubą kultūrinį tapatumą per šieno sriubą, slidinėjimą Dirndlio dieną, polentą kalnų šlaituose ir žvejybą ledyninėse upėse, ir tyrinėja, kaip istorinė pasienio įtampa formavo vietos virtuvę ir kultūrą. Šiame nelygiame regione Stanley tyrinėja, kaip reljefas formuoja maisto kultūrą. Jis kepa avieną ant grotelių avių ūkyje, mėgaujasi prancūziško stiliaus sekmadienio pietumis ir atskleidžia saldžią konfeti istoriją, atskleisdamas netikėtų kulinarinių malonumų.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.desc: Al Pacino, Robert De Niro e Diane Keaton nel sequel premiato con 6 Oscar. Nel 1901 il siciliano Don Vito raggiunge gli Stati Uniti e getta le fondamenta del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Le Déluge: Gli ultimi giorni di Maria Antonietta
programme.desc: Gianluca Jodice dirige una pellicola, premiata con 4 David e 2 Nastri d'Argento, che indaga le psicologie di Luigi XVI (Guillaume Canet) e Maria Antonietta (Melanie Laurent).

programme.title: Page Eight
programme.desc: Dopo la morte del suo capo, un agente dell'MI5 si ritrova in possesso di importanti e scottanti informazioni top-secret.

programme.title: Diana - La storia segreta di Lady D
programme.desc: Naomi Watts interpreta la principessa piu' amata di sempre nel film che ne ricostruisce la favola tragica, fra cronaca e retroscena. Dalla separazione dal Principe Carlo all'amore spezzato per Hasnat Khan, fino alla notte di Parigi in cui Diana perse la vita in un incidente.

programme.title: Old Man & the Gun
programme.desc: Robert Redford, Casey Affleck e Sissy Spacek nella biografia di un rapinatore ‘gentiluomo’. Il film racconta la vita di Forrest Tucker, autore di un numero imprecisato di rapine in banca. Un criminale seriale che ha affascinato l’opinione pubblica e che si è reso protagonista di numerose evasioni, persino dopo aver superato i 70 anni quando scappò addirittura dal penitenziario di San Quintino. Sulle sue tracce un detective; al suo fianco una donna che lo amava nonostante tutto. La sceneggiatura, firmata dal regista David Lowery, è ispirata a un reportage apparso su The New Yorker nel 2003.

programme.title: Mi chiamo Francesco Totti
programme.desc: Francesco Totti si racconta nel documentario di Alex Infascelli. Nella notte che precede l'addio al calcio, il capitano della Roma ripercorre le emozioni della sua vita privata e sportiva.

programme.title: Hamnet - Nel nome del figlio
programme.desc: Dall'omonimo romanzo, Chloé Zhao dirige Jessie Buckley, premiata con l'Oscar, e Paul Mescal nel film che racconta uno degli episodi più tragici nella vita dei coniugi Shakespeare.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Il piacere è tutto mio
programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: Salvate il soldato Ryan
programme.desc: 5 Oscar per il film di guerra firmato Steven Spielberg, con Tom Hanks e Matt Damon. Dopo lo sbarco in Normandia, un plotone va in cerca dell'unico soldato superstite di quattro fratelli.

programme.title: Harry Haft: Storia di un sopravvissuto
programme.desc: Biopic di Barry Levinson con Ben Foster. Rinchiuso ad Auschwitz, il pugile polacco Harry Haft e' costretto a combattere con i suoi compagni di prigionia per intrattenere i nazisti.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: Frances O'Connor esordisce alla regia con il biopic sull'autrice di 'Cime tempestose', interpretata da Emma Mackey. L’equilibrio della famiglia Bronte è scosso dall’arrivo del nuovo Pastore.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Hamnet - Nel nome del figlio
programme.desc: Dall'omonimo romanzo, Chloé Zhao dirige Jessie Buckley, premiata con l'Oscar, e Paul Mescal nel film che racconta uno degli episodi più tragici nella vita dei coniugi Shakespeare.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Globo d'Oro e Nastro d'Argento per l’intensa interpretazione di Monica Guerritore, anche regista del commovente film su Anna Magnani.

programme.title: Harry Haft: Storia di un sopravvissuto
programme.desc: Biopic di Barry Levinson con Ben Foster. Rinchiuso ad Auschwitz, il pugile polacco Harry Haft e' costretto a combattere con i suoi compagni di prigionia per intrattenere i nazisti.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Ray
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al biopic su Ray Charles con Jamie Foxx. Dall'infanzia al successo, passando per i suoi controversi lati oscuri, la vita del leggendario "The Genius" della musica black.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: Tom Hanks e Catherine Zeta-Jones in una commedia romantica di Steven Spielberg. Bloccato a New York per motivi politici, un turista si stabilisce in aeroporto e si innamora di una hostess.

programme.title: Notte fantasma
programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce nel noir urbano di Fulvio Risuleo. Roma: un poliziotto sorprende il giovane Tarek a comprare dell'erba e lo costringe a una notte in giro per Roma a bordo della sua macchina.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: Harry Haft: Storia di un sopravvissuto
programme.desc: Biopic di Barry Levinson con Ben Foster. Rinchiuso ad Auschwitz, il pugile polacco Harry Haft e' costretto a combattere con i suoi compagni di prigionia per intrattenere i nazisti.

programme.title: Shelter
programme.desc: Jennifer Connelly e Anthony Mackie in un toccante film di Paul Bettany. Provenienti da mondi diversi, i destini di Hannah e Tahir si incrociano per le strade di New York.

programme.title: Johnny Stecchino
programme.desc: Capolavoro di comicita' diretto e interpretato dal premio Oscar Roberto Benigni. Nel duplice ruolo di un boss latitante e del suo sosia, l'attore toscano si trova coinvolto in una girandola di spassosi equivoci quando si innamora della moglie di un pentito che la mafia ha condannato a morte. La donna, infatti, vuole far credere che l'ingenuo giovanotto sia il marito per farlo eliminare! Sfuggito casualmente ai numerosi agguati, tra esilaranti furti di banane passati alla storia del cinema, il nostro autista forse riuscira' a salvare la pelle...

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Chi segna vince
programme.desc: Commedia sportiva dell'ironico Taika Waititi con Michael Fassbender. Dopo un'umiliante sconfitta, la nazionale delle Samoa Americane ingaggia un nuovo allenatore.

programme.title: Romanzo criminale
programme.desc: Michele Placido dirige Favino, Rossi Stuart, Accorsi, Scamarcio, Santamaria, Fresi e Germano per raccontare ascesa e caduta della Banda della Magliana nell'Italia degli anni 70.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
programme.desc: Versione restaurata del celebre western di Sergio Leone, con Clint Eastwood, Lee Van Cleef ed Eli Wallach. Guerra di secessione americana: tre pistoleri inseguono un carico d'oro.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della spettacolare saga action Fast & Furious, disponibile su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Fast & Furious - Solo parti originali
programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della saga con il ritorno di Vin Diesel, Paul Walker e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic Toretto torna a Los Angeles per vendicare un'amica e ritrova l'agente O'Conner.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham e Idris Elba nel primo spin-off della saga. Gli agenti Hobbs e Shaw si alleano per fermare un terrorista che minaccia di decimare la razza umana con un virus.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della spettacolare saga action Fast & Furious, disponibile su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: A Rio de Janeiro, l'ex truffatore Dom Torretto e l'ex agente di polizia Brian O' Conner uniscono le proprie forze per affrontare un ricco uomo d'affari che li vuole entrambi morti.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Vin Diesel, 'The Rock', Jason Statham e il compianto Paul Walker nel settimo capitolo della saga. Dominic e compagni devono difendersi da un killer deciso a vendicare il fratello.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Tornano i muscoli e i motori della saga blockbuster in un iperbolico ottavo capitolo che schiera Vin Diesel, Jason Statham, Dwayne Johnson, Kurt Russell e il premio Oscar Charlize Theron. Un'affascinante dark lady, Cipher, usa l'arma del ricatto e della seduzione per convincere Dominique Toretto a tradire i suoi amici e a lavorare per lei. Dom entra cosi' nel mondo del terrorismo internazionale: la prima missione, a Berlino, lo vedra' impossessarsi di un ordigno a spese dell'ex compagno di squadra Hobbes. e' solo il punto di partenza di un giro intorno al mondo ad alto tasso di pericolosita'.

programme.desc: Paul Walker e Vin Diesel nel primo entusiasmante capitolo della saga. Un agente di Los Angeles si infiltra nel mondo delle corse clandestine per smascherare una banda di rapinatori.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: John Singleton dirige Paul Walker nel primo sequel della saga. Un ex poliziotto si infiltra sotto falsa identita' nella gang di un narcotrafficante con l'obiettivo di incastrarlo.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Justin Lin dirige Lucas Black nel terzo capitolo della saga action. Per evitare il carcere, un giovane pilota di gare clandestine si trasferisce a Tokyo, ma finisce nel giro della Yakuza.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Russell Crowe e Cate Blanchett. Tornato in patria dopo aver combattuto per l'Inghilterra, un arciere si ribella all'usurpatore del trono di re Riccardo I.

programme.title: Twisters
programme.desc: Il celebre disaster movie ritorna con Daisy Edgar-Jones e Glen Powell. Dopo un fallimento, Kate abbandona le sue ricerche sui tornado, ma un amico la convince a tornare.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Sam Neill nel terzo capitolo della saga con protagoniste le bestie preistoriche. Il paleontologo Grant torna sull'isola di Sorna e scopre l'esistenza di nuovi mostri più evoluti.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - La compagnia dell'anello
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Un giovane hobbit entra in possesso di un anello dai poteri straordinari.

programme.title: La mummia
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar 2023 Brendan Fraser nel primo capitolo di una saga avventurosa. Un gruppo di esploratori risveglia la salma di un sacerdote egizio colpito da un'antica maledizione.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Russell Crowe e Cate Blanchett. Tornato in patria dopo aver combattuto per l'Inghilterra, un arciere si ribella all'usurpatore del trono di re Riccardo I.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.title: Shark - Il primo squalo
programme.desc: Jason Statham in un action ambientato negli abissi. Un esperto in missioni impossibili deve salvare un team di esploratori da un megalodonte, una specie estinta milioni di anni fa.

programme.title: La mummia - Il ritorno
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser e Rachel Weisz in un'avventura tra le leggende egizie. Il risveglio dal sonno eterno del Re Scorpione e del sacerdote Imhotep costringe due archeologi a entrare in azione.

programme.title: 65 - Fuga dalla Terra
programme.desc: Adam Driver nel fanta-action prodotto da Sam Raimi. Quando un'astronave precipita su un pianeta sconosciuto, due superstiti scoprono di trovarsi sulla Terra di 65 milioni di anni fa.

programme.title: Moschettieri del re: La penultima missione
programme.desc: Giovanni Veronesi dirige Piefrancesco Favino, Sergio Rubini, Rocco Papaleo e Valerio Mastandrea nella commedia sulle nuove imprese dei tre moschettieri e D'Artagnan.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel primo capitolo della nuova trilogia prodotta da Spielberg. Per attrarre più visitatori, gli scienziati progettano un dinosauro geneticamente modificato.

programme.title: King Arthur: Il potere della spada
programme.desc: Guy Ritchie rilegge il mito di Re Artù, con Charlie Hunnam e Jude Law. Cresciuto nei sobborghi di Londra, Arthur estrae la spada dalla roccia e sfida Vortigern per sedere sul trono.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Le due Torri
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al secondo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson, dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Dopo la scissione della Compagnia dell'Anello, Gollum insegue Frodo e Sam, diretti a Mordor.

programme.title: La mummia - Il ritorno
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser e Rachel Weisz in un'avventura tra le leggende egizie. Il risveglio dal sonno eterno del Re Scorpione e del sacerdote Imhotep costringe due archeologi a entrare in azione.

programme.title: King Kong
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al reboot firmato Peter Jackson, con Naomi Watts, Jack Black e Adrien Brody. Anni '30: su un'isola remota una troupe di documentaristi si imbatte in un gigantesco gorilla.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Tom Hiddleston, Brie Larson e Samuel L. Jackson nel reboot sulle origini di Kong. Un gruppo di esploratori scopre un mondo primordiale in cui regna un gigantesco gorilla.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova analizzano la serie Downton Abbey.

programme.title: Me contro Te presenta: Cattivissimi a Natale
programme.desc: Me contro Te presenta: Cattivissimi a Natale.

programme.title: Lego Batman - Il film
programme.desc: Animazione digitale e mattoncini Lego si combinano di nuovo per un’avventura targata DC. Batman si allea con la Justice League per sconfiggere i supercattivi capitanati da Joker.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Oscar 2012 al miglior film d'animazione. Un bizzarro camaleonte giunge in una cittadina del selvaggio West oppressa dalla siccità e da una spietata banda di fuorilegge senza scrupoli.

programme.title: Ghosthunters - Gli acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me
programme.desc: Primo capitolo dell'animazione campione d'incassi targata Illumination. Aiutato dai Minions, il perfido Gru escogita un piano per rubare la Luna, ma 3 orfanelle tentano di ostacolarli.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: Pets - Vita da animali
programme.desc: Animali domestici all'arrembaggio nel successo d'animazione targato Illumination. Il tenero cagnolino Max si allea con il randagio Duke per fermare il piano del coniglio Nevosetto.

programme.title: Un bel giorno
